title: Design System: Ctrl Z — Editorial Homepage

display.purpose: Bold Ctrl Z opening title; mobile uses clamp(4rem, 22vw, 6rem).

label.purpose: Navigation and supporting links; mobile navigation uses 12px.

caption.purpose: Preview captions, entry notes and supporting status.

brand.purpose: Existing compact header wordmark; mobile uses 20px, distinct from the display title.

preview-option.purpose: Existing compact manual comparison buttons; not a body-copy size.

preview-note.purpose: Existing supporting comparison note and its game-entry link.

preview-state.purpose: Discrete connected, interruption and disconnected status.

motion.name: entry-hover
motion.purpose: Primary entry hover feedback; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: entry-press
motion.purpose: Primary entry press feedback; transition and movement removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: navigation-hover
motion.purpose: Navigation contrast and underline feedback; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: local-blackout-reveal
motion.purpose: Natural local scroll drives an aligned blackout layer through requestAnimationFrame CSS writes, without a CSS transition or React render per pixel. Manual endpoints persist until the complete preview leaves view. Re-entry resumes automatic control; direct #preview starts connected. Reduced motion uses stable connected presentation and instant manual endpoints, with no edge. No entrance animations, loops, pinning or scroll interception.

components.name: Primary Entry Action
components.description: The clear, restrained action used to enter the live simulation.
components.css: .ds-enter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 13px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.65; background: var(--page-accent); color: var(--page-ground); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-enter:hover { background: var(--page-ink); } .ds-enter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--page-accent); outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-enter:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-enter { transition: none; } .ds-enter:active { transform: none; } }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; align-items: center; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; color: var(--page-ink); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; transition: color 160ms ease-out, text-decoration-color 160ms ease-out; text-underline-offset: 5px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--page-accent); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-nav .ds-entry-link { color: var(--page-accent); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--page-accent); outline-offset: 6px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-nav { gap: 16px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-nav > a:first-child { display: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav a { transition: none; } }

components.name: Gameplay Preview Switch
components.description: Manual endpoints override the local scroll reveal until the preview leaves view; neither option is pressed during a partial reveal. Reduced-motion switching is instant.
components.css: .ds-preview-switch { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: var(--page-raised); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-preview-switch button { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--page-muted); border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 3px; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-preview-switch button[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--page-ground); background: var(--page-accent); } .ds-preview-switch button:hover { color: var(--page-ink); } .ds-preview-switch button[aria-pressed='true']:hover { color: var(--page-ground); } .ds-preview-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--page-accent); outline-offset: 6px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-preview-switch { width: 100%; } .ds-preview-switch button { flex: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
**Direction — Editorial, with consequence (UI_REDESIGN.md).** Retain the asymmetric editorial composition, geometric Manrope and cool graphite/cyan palette. Keep motion restrained: one natural-scroll powered/blackout comparison carries the signature, with instant manual endpoints for reduced motion. Reject a full-screen cinematic hero and pinned scroll spacer. A shallow authentic city glimpse supports the wordmark; the existing playable game remains isolated and protected.

Strong typography and clean hierarchy introduce the playable city through a dark reading surface, generous spacing and restrained neon accents. Open text blocks and actual game previews carry the presentation. The mood is calm, direct and precise; the controls feel clear and restrained.

This system applies only to the homepage implemented in `src/Landing.tsx`, `src/BlackoutPreview.tsx`, `src/useBlackoutReveal.ts` and `src/landing.css`, loaded by `src/landing-main.tsx` through `index.html`. The embedded and full-screen game at `simulation.html` is a separate, approved system. Its `src/console.css` and `src/style.css`, HUD, controls, service identities, city artwork, renderer, camera, simulation and saves remain protected. These landing tokens must not replace incumbent game tokens. The city retains the Antahonist Neon City direction, secondary `design/pixel-city-reference-2.png` inspiration and commit-27 lineage; rejected commit-28/29 designs remain excluded.
keyCharacteristics: Generous spacing and open text blocks.
Dark overall theme with restrained neon accents.
Actual gameplay imagery with clear preview captions.
A local, aligned blackout reveal with manual control.
An isolated, on-demand playable game below the introduction.

rules.name: The Restrained Neon Rule
rules.body: Use window cyan for entry, selection and focus; let the actual city previews carry the richer game palette.

rules.name: The Clean Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Establish emphasis with size, weight and space; preserve readable text rather than adding tracked eyebrows or ornamental labels.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep editorial surfaces flat; reserve tonal layering for the preview switch and closing invitation.

dos: **Do** use strong typography, clean hierarchy and generous spacing.
**Do** use window cyan for entry, selection and focus.
**Do** use actual game previews with readable captions and accurate alternative text.
**Do** keep paired captures aligned in the same bounded crop and let manual choice persist until the preview leaves view.
**Do** preserve visible keyboard focus, touch target sizes and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep homepage styles isolated from the approved game system.
donts: **Don't** introduce generic SaaS cards, glass, decorative glow or ornamental cyberpunk clutter into the homepage.
**Don't** invent metrics, testimonials, awards or unimplemented gameplay scenarios.
**Don't** replace the protected game UI, city artwork or game tokens with this landing system.
**Don't** add tracked eyebrows, section numbers or decorative icon grids to establish hierarchy.
